review_candidates.title: SVP - International Information Security, Egypt
review_candidates.description_excerpt: This role is responsible for ensuring alignment between regional information security functions and Mashreq's global security strategy, regulatory obligations, and risk management framework. Key Responsibilities 1. Lead and manage regional Information Security teams across multiple countries, ensuring consistent standards while accommodating local regulatory and operational requirements. Establish and maintain governance frameworks, security policies, standards, and procedures across internation
eligibility_evidence: Mashreq is seeking an experienced and strategic Head of Information Security International to lead and oversee information security operations across its international network, including the USA, Egypt, Qatar, Bahrain, Kuwait, Pakistan, India, the United Kingdom, and Hong Kong.

The successful candidate will provide leadership to regional Information Security teams, drive governance and compliance initiatives, manage international security risks, and act as the Information Security lead for Mashreq's London and Hong Kong businesses.

This is a senior leadership opportunity for a cybersecurity professional with extensive international banking experience and a strong understanding of global security, regulatory, and data protection frameworks.
Develop and execute a rolling multi-year Information Security roadmap for international operations, aligned with Mashreq's global security strategy and business objectives.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Lead and manage regional Information Security teams across multiple countries, ensuring consistent standards while accommodating local regulatory and operational requirements. Ensure compliance with local and international regulatory requirements, security standards, and data privacy laws across all jurisdictions. Experience, Skills & Qualifications 1. Minimum 14 years of information security experience, including at least 5 years leading international security teams within a large multinational organization. In-depth understanding of global cybersecurity and data privacy regulations such as GDPR, HKMA, FFIEC, NYDFS, RBI Cyber Security Framework, PDPL, and related regulatory requirements. Strong expertise in information security governance, risk management, incident response, third-party risk management, and security operations.
